csv_project_name: Design for Commercial Street Intersection Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Branson (COB) is requesting the submittal of qualifications for intersection realignment and improvements of Commercial Steet and Branson Landing Blvd (BLB). The improvements shall include updated traffic signals, traffic signal cabinets and controls, pedestrian crossings with detection devices, and ADA compliant sidewalks with curb and gutter. This project is going to require collaboration, review and permits from the (MNA) Missouri and Northern Arkansas Railroad. Design Services: The design services shall include but are not limited to surveying, geotechnical investigations, traffic studies and reports, ADA compliance survey, sidewalk improvements, landscape, curb realignments, intersection design, roadway design, contract documents, assisting with the bid documents, utility coordination/permits, and temporary and permanent traffic controls design. These services will include preparation of plans, specifications, estimates (PS&E), and final documents.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies
